chapter: High school, Dizzy and Wayne State
title: Correcting the name: Eddie Durham and the first electric guitar
summary: Brown and Burrell sort out that Eddie Durham, not Ernie, was the first electric guitarist and helped Charlie Christian.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Well, I remember there was somebody Collins, but I don’t…
There it is, that’s the guy.
‘Cause you said Ernie, so that threw me, I was thinking Ernie Wilkins, I know it’s not Ernie Wilkins.
But Eddie Durham was the first, yeah, he was the first.
Yeah, he was the first and he also helped Charlie Christian.
Are we running? [to Kimery] Kimery: Yeah.
Okay, good. So we clear that up, we got Eddie Durham as the guitarist who inspired Charlie Christian…
